answers.core: Solution is small, needs to be close to source, workaround demands an entire script dedicated to solving a UI/UX issue
answers.workaround:
A workaround script was proposed here https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/82524#issuecomment-1741260115 but it assumes no other top-level nodes would like this input

Also, I believe this functionality was so old no one paid it much thought, and it's just common sense to make it optional once re-discovered.
